frequency_question: How often do central bank liquidity restriction announcements properly use the exact required acronym and fall within a prescribed calendar window given that the policy decision to implement liquidity tightening has been made?
membership_rule: Includes all announcements of incremental or supplementary reserve ratio requirements by major central banks; excludes permanent ratio changes or overnight repo operations.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; universe of exact equivalent targeted temporary ratio instruments in modern RBI history is small.
known_gaps: Extremely rare policy tool, limited sample size.
skeleton: named historical deployment of targeted liquidity instruments by the central bank matching precise statutory definitions
multiplier: 3 hits out of 3 total similar distinct historical deployment episodes where the policy tool was formally activated under the specific nomenclature.
validity_reason: Central bank drafting conventions and press release protocols change slowly over multi-year horizons.
